Copyright.AdditionalInfo: sites processed on April 2, 2018. Of the sites: kan001a - has an E line cut about halfway through run. kan003a - short run, but has an E line cut 1/3 of the way through kan003b - run failed to record kan003c - has an E line cut early in the run kan004b - run failed due to the erroneous 'GPS mode' I have processed the data 3 ways: 'full' - runs with failed E (001a, 003a, 003c) were processed in their entirety and are most appropriate as references for other sites. '001_E' - the trimmed version of 001a was used for all reference combinations. Appropriate for TFs at 001. '003_E' - the trimmed versions of 003a and 003c were used for all reference combinations. Appropriate for TFs at 003. The final FC files are for the 'full' versions of all runs.
